Name: Faun's More Emo Nyapu Sebastian
Author: sleepiestfaun
Description:
Yippee I forgot that I had done this a little bit ago and decided to share it. It's just a simple edit of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's amazing portrait mod[/url] to make Sebastian a little uh, edgier? More Emo?

This is inspired in part by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24884]Cyberzkull's Sebastian[/url] as well, so check that mod out if you'd prefer a more vanilla emo boy lol

This is the image files, so drop them in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Nyapu's Portraits(1.6.9)\assets, or wherever you keep your SDV mods

Downloads.Description: Unzip and Drag and drop the [CP] Nyapu's Portraits(1.6.9) folder into your mods folder- allow it to replace the files
